verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI offers bot-detection evasion (undetected browser support), persistent auth profiles/cookies, and retry/proxy chains that help avoid blocks and reuse logins, but there's no evidence of autonomous CAPTCHA-solving or agent-driven login/form-wall completion without manual setup of profiles/credentials beforehand. Community feedback explicitly flags login/session handling and bot mitigation as 'boring production bits' users must own themselves, not a built-in autonomous capability.
